Name: Simon Says No
Author: TheLimeyDragon
Description:
This adds an event where Qi will simply give you walnuts in case you don't want to play the Simon Says Memory Game.

It does not complete the mini game for you, and you can still play it if desired (and you'd also get 3 additional walnuts if you did)

I've not tested it with online multiplayer.
